facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced by fact_new_2: the deal was renegotiated so the goblins wall off the stairs and keep only the upper rooms

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the goblins accepted a new deal that no longer requires clearing the mound

facts.text: Wayman promised Snurk of the Free Goblin Society never to tell King Hogboon where the goblins are, should he meet him.

The Free Goblin Society (Watak, Grimble, Snurk and Peg) are on friendly terms with the party and now hold the Barrow Mound's church, antechamber and statue room, having agreed to wall off the stairs below; they mean to destroy the church as their first act.
